explication: StreamDiffusion is a real-time diffusion image-generation library with interactive text-to-image, image-to-image, and video demos. The principal workflow is: a user supplies a prompt or frame, a demo API manages the session, StreamDiffusion prepares prompts and latent state, performs accelerated denoising, decodes the result, and returns an image or stream frame. The sampled code directly supports TensorRT replacement, image similarity filtering, WebSocket queues, and browser-facing APIs; other documented optimizations remain encapsulated in the core pipeline.
